source: wfactory README at commit ee9fd85, before a hand-done pass that read it top to bottom and listed what a newcomer had not been told. These are the problems that pass found and fixed.
reader: One developer with a personal project and a Claude Max plan. They use Claude Code daily. They have never seen wfactory and know nothing about how it works inside.

problems.what: "check" has no explanation or example until two-thirds of the way down
"the tracker" is used five times and never explained
"That part" could be the setup conversation or the program underneath
"With a git remote" raises a question nothing answers
"collect in one place" does not say where
"All of these are code" contrasts with prompt-only rules the text no longer mentions
"reviewer agent" and "fresh read-only session" are two names for one thing
the enforcement list and step 3 disagree about what decides "done"
"shared code" is stated without saying what it is or why it matters
"a broken main" is stated without saying what broken means
the second paragraph promises usage limits and nothing delivers them
